name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €85/MWh, easing on hopes of a US–Iran deal but above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route impeded
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €85/MWh on 10 Nov, slightly below the €86 close of 6 Nov and still above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). The Strait of Hormuz, the route for Qatari LNG, remains well below normal: UKMTO counted traffic about 65% below pre-conflict levels as of 10 Nov, with at least 11 ships attacked in the week to 6 Nov (Gulf News).
for_you: Wholesale gas well above normal feeds through to household energy bills and industrial costs over the coming months. Ofgem sets the GB price cap; check its announcements for when changes take effect.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF natural gas futures (TTF=F)
Gulf News — Hormuz shipping 'below normal, but not stalled': UKMTO

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
